notes.title: 72 Hours Until Release!
notes.notes:
Not long to go now!

I'm spending the last moments to make tweaks to the UI, and make everything as intuitive as possible. 
I'm also play-testing to find any sneaky bugs that might be hidden away in there.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34060603/f8aa195571c855021cb39a3db9be7b9571087c94.png[/img]

I would like to give my thanks to the community.
I have received lots of encouragement and support for this product on Reddit and Twitter, as well as some helpful discussion on the Community Hub.

https://www.reddit.com/r/Chieftain/
https://twitter.com/ChieftainGame

Going forward, I hope to patch any issues as soon as they arise! Keep me informed if any issues are found!
And I hope everyone has a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
